list.text: The degree to which a person can grow is directly proportional to the amount of truth he can accept about himself without running away.
list.author: Leland Val Van De Wall

list.text: Do not disturb yourself by imagining your whole life at once.
list.author: Marcus Aurelius

list.text: The electric light did not come from the continuous improvement of candles.
list.author: Oren Harari
